answer: The jade escrow holds each stake, the tide settlement releases it, and the signal audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 27% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A farm running 57 keys therefore forfeits that exposure 57 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. That is 2 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
